svg.title: West2online — four-line type grid
svg.desc: Transparent 4 by 4 grid with eleven monospace characters. Uppercase W and orange 2 are complete; n and lowercase o show their upper half; e is cut vertically, and t is cut through its stem center. Every cell has four handwriting rules. Small copy remains editable. The original West2 Online logo occupies the bottom-right cell.
